q.en: How do you keep a surprise party secret during setup and RSVP collection?

a.en: All communication and digital invitations include explicit confidential arrival windows (typically 30 to 45 minutes before the guest of honour arrives), and our styling and catering crew complete bump-in behind closed doors before guests enter.

q.en: Can you set up a surprise party at a private Perth home in under two hours?

a.en: Yes. When the guest of honour is taken out for a decoy dinner or outing, our Perth styling and hire crew can deploy pre-built balloon arches, neon signage, grazing stations, and bar setups within a tight two-hour window.

q.en: Do your surprise party packages include RSA bar staff and dietary catering?

a.en: Yes. Every guest RSVP captures dietary and allergy requirements, and our packages can include WA RSA-certified bartenders, glassware hire, and tailored grazing or cocktail menus.
